verses.original: רָנִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה לֹ֣א יָלָ֑דָה פִּצְחִ֨י רִנָּ֤ה וְצַהֲלִי֙ לֹא־ חָ֔לָה כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֧ים בְּֽנֵי־ שׁוֹמֵמָ֛ה מִבְּנֵ֥י בְעוּלָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rān·nî ‘ă·qā·rāh lō yā·lā·ḏāh piṣ·ḥî rin·nāh wə·ṣa·hă·lî lō- ḥā·lāh kî- rab·bîm bə·nê- šō·w·mê·māh mib·bə·nê ḇə·‘ū·lāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Shout for joy O barren woman who bears no children break forth in song and cry aloud you who have never travailed because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband says the LORD

verses.original: הַרְחִ֣יבִי׀ מְק֣וֹם אָהֳלֵ֗ךְ וִירִיע֧וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַ֛יִךְ יַטּ֖וּ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֑כִי הַאֲרִ֙יכִי֙ מֵֽיתָרַ֔יִךְ וִיתֵדֹתַ֖יִךְ חַזֵּֽקִי׃
verses.transliteration: har·ḥî·ḇî mə·qō·wm ’ā·ho·lêḵ wî·rî·‘ō·wṯ miš·kə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ yaṭ·ṭū ’al- taḥ·śō·ḵî ha·’ă·rî·ḵî mê·ṯā·ra·yiḵ wî·ṯê·ḏō·ṯa·yiḵ ḥaz·zê·qî
verses.literal: Enlarge the site of your tent stretch out the curtains of your dwellings do not hold back Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep . . .

verses.original: כִּי־ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֖אול תִּפְרֹ֑צִי וְזַרְעֵךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם יִירָ֔שׁ וְעָרִ֥ים נְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl tip̄·rō·ṣî wə·zar·‘êḵ gō·w·yim yî·rāš wə·‘ā·rîm nə·šam·mō·wṯ yō·wō·šî·ḇū
verses.literal: For you will spread out to the right and left your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א תֵב֔וֹשִׁי וְאַל־ תִּכָּלְמִ֖י כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תַחְפִּ֑ירִי כִּ֣י בֹ֤שֶׁת עֲלוּמַ֙יִךְ֙ תִּשְׁכָּ֔חִי וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת אַלְמְנוּתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î kî- lō ṯê·ḇō·wō·šî wə·’al- tik·kā·lə·mî kî lō ṯaḥ·pî·rî kî ḇō·šeṯ ‘ă·lū·ma·yiḵ tiš·kā·ḥî wə·ḥer·paṯ ’al·mə·nū·ṯa·yiḵ lō ṯiz·kə·rî- ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid for you will not be put to shame do not be intimidated for you will not be humiliated For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood

verses.original: כִּ֤י בֹעֲלַ֙יִךְ֙ עֹשַׂ֔יִךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ וְגֹֽאֲלֵךְ֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ יִקָּרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇō·‘ă·la·yiḵ ‘ō·śa·yiḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·lō·hê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ yiq·qā·rê
verses.literal: For your husband is your Maker the LORD of Hosts is His name the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer He is called the God of all the earth

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כְאִשָּׁ֧ה עֲזוּבָ֛ה וַעֲצ֥וּבַת ר֖וּחַ קְרָאָ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֧שֶׁת נְעוּרִ֛ים כִּ֥י תִמָּאֵ֖ס אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵə·’iš·šāh ‘ă·zū·ḇāh wa·‘ă·ṣū·ḇaṯ rū·aḥ qə·rā·’āḵ Yah·weh wə·’ê·šeṯ nə·‘ū·rîm kî ṯim·mā·’ês ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ
verses.literal: For the LORD has called you back like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit like the rejected wife of one’s youth says your God

verses.original: בְּרֶ֥גַע קָטֹ֖ן עֲזַבְתִּ֑יךְ וּבְרַחֲמִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲקַבְּצֵֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For a brief moment I forsook you but with great compassion I will bring you back

verses.original: בְּשֶׁ֣צֶף קֶ֗צֶף הִסְתַּ֨רְתִּי פָנַ֥י רֶ֙גַע֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עוֹלָ֖ם רִֽחַמְתִּ֑יךְ אָמַ֥ר גֹּאֲלֵ֖ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·še·ṣep̄ qe·ṣep̄ his·tar·tî p̄ā·nay re·ḡa‘ mim·mêḵ ū·ḇə·ḥe·seḏ ‘ō·w·lām ri·ḥam·tîḵ ’ā·mar gō·’ă·lêḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you says the LORD your Redeemer

verses.original: כִּי־ מֵ֥י נֹ֙חַ֙ זֹ֣את לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי מֵעֲבֹ֥ר מֵי־ נֹ֛חַ ע֖וֹד עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי מִקְּצֹ֥ף עָלַ֖יִךְ וּמִגְּעָר־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mê nō·aḥ zōṯ lî ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî mê·‘ă·ḇōr mê- nō·aḥ ‘ō·wḏ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ kên niš·ba‘·tî miq·qə·ṣōp̄ ‘ā·la·yiḵ ū·mig·gə·‘ār- bāḵ
verses.literal: For to Me this is like the days of Noah when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יָמ֔וּשׁוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת תְּמוּטֶ֑נָה וְחַסְדִּ֞י מֵאִתֵּ֣ךְ לֹֽא־ יָמ֗וּשׁ וּבְרִ֤ית שְׁלוֹמִי֙ לֹ֣א תָמ֔וּט אָמַ֥ר מְרַחֲמֵ֖ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî he·hā·rîm yā·mū·šū wə·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ tə·mū·ṭe·nāh wə·ḥas·dî mê·’it·têḵ lō- yā·mūš ū·ḇə·rîṯ šə·lō·w·mî lō ṯā·mūṭ ’ā·mar mə·ra·ḥă·mêḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken My loving devotion . . . will not depart from you and My covenant of peace will not be broken says the LORD who has compassion on you

verses.original: עֲנִיָּ֥ה סֹעֲרָ֖ה לֹ֣א נֻחָ֑מָה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַרְבִּ֤יץ בַּפּוּךְ֙ אֲבָנַ֔יִךְ וִיסַדְתִּ֖יךְ בַּסַּפִּירִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nî·yāh sō·‘ă·rāh lō nu·ḥā·māh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mar·bîṣ bap·pūḵ ’ă·ḇā·na·yiḵ wî·saḏ·tîḵ bas·sap·pî·rîm
verses.literal: O afflicted city lashed by storms without solace surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י כַּֽדְכֹד֙ שִׁמְשֹׁתַ֔יִךְ וּשְׁעָרַ֖יִךְ לְאַבְנֵ֣י אֶקְדָּ֑ח וְכָל־ גְּבוּלֵ֖ךְ לְאַבְנֵי־ חֵֽפֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî kaḏ·ḵōḏ šim·šō·ṯa·yiḵ ū·šə·‘ā·ra·yiḵ lə·’aḇ·nê ’eq·dāḥ wə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·lêḵ lə·’aḇ·nê- ḥê·p̄eṣ
verses.literal: I will make your pinnacles of rubies your gates of sparkling jewels and all your walls of precious stones

verses.original: וְכָל־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ לִמּוּדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְרַ֖ב שְׁל֥וֹם בָּנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl bā·na·yiḵ lim·mū·ḏê Yah·weh wə·raḇ šə·lō·wm bā·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD and great will be their prosperity

verses.original: בִּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּכּוֹנָ֑נִי רַחֲקִ֤י מֵעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ כִּֽי־ לֹ֣א תִירָ֔אִי וּמִ֨מְּחִתָּ֔ה כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ תִקְרַ֖ב אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: biṣ·ḏā·qāh tik·kō·w·nā·nî ra·ḥă·qî mê·‘ō·šeq kî- lō ṯî·rā·’î ū·mim·mə·ḥit·tāh kî lō- ṯiq·raḇ ’ê·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: In righteousness you will be established far from oppression for you will have no fear Terror will be far removed for it will not come near you

verses.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֥וֹר יָג֛וּר אֶ֖פֶס מֵֽאוֹתִ֑י מִי־ גָ֥ר אִתָּ֖ךְ עָלַ֥יִךְ יִפּֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: hên gō·wr yā·ḡūr ’e·p̄es mê·’ō·w·ṯî mî- ḡār ’it·tāḵ ‘ā·la·yiḵ yip·pō·wl
verses.literal: If anyone attacks you . . . it is not from Me whoever assails you . . . will fall before you

verses.original: הֵן אָֽנֹכִי֙ בָּרָ֣אתִי חָרָ֔שׁ נֹפֵ֙חַ֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ פֶּחָ֔ם וּמוֹצִ֥יא כְלִ֖י לְמַעֲשֵׂ֑הוּ וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּרָ֥אתִי מַשְׁחִ֖ית לְחַבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hēn ’ā·nō·ḵî bā·rā·ṯî ḥā·rāš nō·p̄ê·aḥ bə·’êš pe·ḥām ū·mō·w·ṣî ḵə·lî lə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū wə·’ā·nō·ḵî bā·rā·ṯî maš·ḥîṯ lə·ḥab·bêl
verses.literal: Behold I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc

verses.original: כָּל־ כְּלִ֞י יוּצַ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א יִצְלָ֔ח וְכָל־ לָשׁ֛וֹן תָּֽקוּם־ אִתָּ֥ךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט תַּרְשִׁ֑יעִי זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ עַבְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה וְצִדְקָתָ֛ם מֵאִתִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- kə·lî yū·ṣar ‘ā·la·yiḵ lō yiṣ·lāḥ wə·ḵāl lā·šō·wn tā·qūm- ’it·tāḵ lam·miš·pāṭ tar·šî·‘î zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯām mê·’it·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: No weapon formed against you shall prosper and you will refute every tongue that accuses . . . you This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD and their vindication is from Me declares the LORD
